posts.name: Katrina Kaif
posts.caption: Katrina shared her 'May photo dump' featuring adorable glimpses of baby Vihaan, Vicky Kaushal's 38th birthday celebration, and romantic moments from their family getaway.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Diljit announced a historic Wembley Stadium show on Sept 12 — the first South Asian artist to headline the venue — and screened the Main Vaapas Aaunga trailer at his packed Toronto AURA Tour concert.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Bobby Deol dismissed rumors of a clash with Alia on the Alpha set, praising her professionalism. Her YRF spy thriller Alpha has been preponed to July 3 release.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Priyanka shared poolside self-care moments on her day off and continues filming SS Rajamouli's ₹1,300 crore epic Varanasi with Mahesh Babu, with Antarctica shoots confirmed.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: SRK's King confirmed for Christmas 2026 release with a ₹350 crore budget. He declined a Jailer 2 cameo with Rajinikanth to protect the exclusivity of his return alongside daughter Suhana's debut.

posts.name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
posts.caption: Kareena is in advanced talks to reunite with Salman Khan in Raj & DK's superhero film, and her Meghna Gulzar-directed thriller Daayra with Prithviraj Sukumaran is in production.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Shraddha is in talks to play the female lead opposite Vicky Kaushal in Maddock Films' mythological epic Mahavatar, while also preparing for a period musical drama directed by Laxman Utekar.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Deepika and Ranveer announced their second pregnancy and were spotted at a family wedding in coordinated red outfits, with unseen pictures going viral. She's set to return in SRK's King.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Ranveer's Dhurandhar 2 crossed ₹1,800 crore worldwide, becoming the highest-grossing Indian film without China. His next film Pralay, a post-apocalyptic thriller, begins shooting in August.

posts.name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
posts.caption: Aishwarya was announced as JW Marriott's Global Brand Ambassador and defended by Madhuri Dixit against body-shaming trolls over her Cannes 2026 royal blue gown appearance.

posts.name: Rashmika Mandanna
posts.caption: Rashmika is reuniting with Allu Arjun in Atlee's sci-fi epic AA22xA6 as the main villain — a bold departure from her Pushpa persona. Her wedding to Vijay Deverakonda was held in Udaipur in February.

posts.name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
posts.caption: Samantha's self-produced Telugu film Maa Inti Bangaram adds Gulshan Devaiah to its cast. She stars as a gun-wielding protagonist in this thriller reuniting her with director Nandini Reddy.

posts.name: Allu Arjun
posts.caption: Allu Arjun is filming Atlee's massive sci-fi epic AA22xA6 with multiple roles alongside Deepika, Rashmika, and Janhvi Kapoor, set for a 2027 global release on an unprecedented scale.

posts.name: Ram Charan
posts.caption: Ram Charan's sports drama Peddi releases June 4 with a ₹500 crore worldwide target. AR Rahman's soundtrack hit 'Chikiri Chikiri' has crossed 200 million YouTube views.

posts.name: Jr NTR
posts.caption: Jr NTR's Dragon first glimpse smashed 105 million YouTube views in one week. He's confirmed a four-film lineup including War 2 with Hrithik Roshan (Aug 14), Dragon, Devara 2, and a Nelson film.

posts.name: Janhvi Kapoor
posts.caption: Janhvi stars alongside Ram Charan in Peddi, releasing June 4, and has joined Allu Arjun's mega sci-fi project AA22xA6 directed by Atlee, cementing her pan-India crossover.

posts.name: Ananya Panday
posts.caption: Ananya is part of the Bollywood summer bangs trend alongside Priyanka and Shraddha. Triptii Dimri defended her against trolling over a Chand Mera Dil dance scene.

posts.name: Kiara Advani
posts.caption: Kiara opened up about societal pressure on new mothers to 'bounce back' after welcoming daughter Saraayah with Sidharth Malhotra. She's set to appear in Yash's Toxic.

posts.name: Hrithik Roshan
posts.caption: Hrithik is making his directorial debut with the ₹350 crore superhero epic Krrish 4, reuniting with Priyanka Chopra. He'll also appear in Alpha as Major Kabir Dhaliwal.

posts.name: Varun Dhawan
posts.caption: Varun's rom-com Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai with David Dhawan releases June 5 after navigating a box-office clash with Yash's Toxic, which was eventually postponed.

posts.name: Shreya Ghoshal
posts.caption: Shreya released heartfelt new song 'Siddha Bhajo' — her late father's favorite — and announced 'The Unstoppable Tour' hitting Auckland, Sydney, Melbourne, and a massive US run in September.

posts.name: AR Rahman
posts.caption: AR Rahman's Peddi soundtrack is a massive hit — 'Chikiri Chikiri' crossed 200M YouTube views. He performed live at a grand musical event in Bhopal alongside Ram Charan ahead of the June 4 release.

posts.name: Vijay Thalapathy
posts.caption: Vijay's farewell film Jana Nayagan is eyeing a July release window after Toxic took the June 4 slot. The ₹500 crore+ political drama marks his final film before full-time politics.
